hardening: Case-folded duplicate request headers fail closed instead of being silently overwritten
Non-enumerable and symbol request-header properties fail closed
JSON array and scalar responses fail closed; the adapter accepts JSON objects only
Projection of a literal __proto__ field preserves an ordinary result prototype
Receipt validation enforces PASS/FAIL_CLOSED semantic relationships after receipt-root recomputation
Known Node environment and CLI proxy switches fail closed before fetch
boundary: This is local candidate evidence for one TINP-owned read-only HTTP policy adapter; it rejects the known proxy environment variables and Node environment-proxy switches but does not prove that an externally installed runtime dispatcher cannot proxy requests. It does not prove independent third-party interoperability, cross-host transport, production credentials, or general network authority.
